# reading

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:profModalityReading`](gmeow-profModalityReading.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/profModalityReading>

- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reading proficiency modality — a specific skill channel (receptive, productive, signing, etc.) on which proficiency is assessed.
